types.name: Account
types.doc: One account: its balance, its points, how many postings it took and their amounts.

types.name: Ledger
types.doc: Accounts by id, numbered from 1 in the order they were opened, and a tally of postings per kind.

funcs.name: post
funcs.doc: Records one amount: a deposit adds it, a withdrawal or a fee takes it; the balance wraps as a long does.

funcs.name: award
funcs.doc: Adds n points, which may be negative; the total wraps as an int does.

funcs.name: reach
funcs.doc: How many leading amounts it takes to reach target, or -1.

funcs.name: open
funcs.doc: Opens an account and returns its number.

funcs.name: post
funcs.doc: Posts a positive amount; a withdrawal may not overdraw, a fee may.

funcs.name: award
funcs.doc: Awards points to an account and returns its new total.

funcs.name: tallied
funcs.doc: The postings tallied over every kind; the order of the kinds does not change a sum.
